Sql.ArtigosQuery: SELECT a.Artigo AS Codigo, a.Descricao AS Nome, a.Familia AS Familia, f.Descricao AS FamiliaNome, a.CDU_MTImagem AS Imagem, a.CDU_MSS_ORDEM AS Ordem FROM PRIMSS2CLO.dbo.Artigo a LEFT JOIN PRIMSS2CLO.dbo.Familias f ON f.Familia = a.Familia WHERE ISNULL(a.ArtigoAnulado, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(a.CDU_PS_ANULAR, 0) = 0 AND (a.Artigo LIKE @LikeSearch OR a.Descricao LIKE @LikeSearch) AND (@Familia = '' OR a.Familia = @Familia) ORDER BY f.Descricao, a.CDU_MSS_ORDEM, a.Artigo OFFSET @Offset ROWS FETCH NEXT @Limit ROWS ONLY
Sql.FamiliasQuery: SELECT DISTINCT a.Familia AS Codigo, f.Descricao AS Nome FROM PRIMSS2CLO.dbo.Artigo a LEFT JOIN PRIMSS2CLO.dbo.Familias f ON f.Familia = a.Familia WHERE ISNULL(a.ArtigoAnulado, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(a.CDU_PS_ANULAR, 0) = 0 AND a.Familia IS NOT NULL AND a.Familia <> '' ORDER BY f.Descricao
